property_summary: Calling newEmergencyOracle succeeds for all accounts, but on P it must revert for non-jojoTeam callers.
A non-jojoTeam call to newEmergencyOracle must revert on the original but succeeds on the mutant.
The owner of the newly deployed EmergencyOracle must be the caller of newEmergencyOracle; the bug sets jojoTeam as the owner instead of msg.sender.
After a call to newEmergencyOracle, the owner of the newly created EmergencyOracle contract must equal the original msg.sender of that call. The mutant incorrectly sets the owner to jojoTeam instead.
For any admissible caller, the owner of the EmergencyOracle contract created by newEmergencyOracle must be the msg.sender of the call; the bug sets it to jojoTeam.
For any caller authorized as jojoTeam, the owner of the EmergencyOracle created by newEmergencyOracle must be the caller; the bug incorrectly sets it to jojoTeam.

For any call to newEmergencyOracle by the authorized jojoTeam, the owner() of the newly deployed EmergencyOracle contract must equal the original msg.sender (which is jojoTeam), but the bug sets the owner to jojoTeam, which coincidentally is the same value only when msg.sender == jojoTeam, so an adversarial caller who is not jojoTeam but authorized via being jojoTeam cannot exist; therefore, we exploit the difference by having a secondary caller who is not the jojoTeam set in c, making the bug incorrectly set the owner to jojoTeam instead of the actual msg.sender.
